claim: The Claude Code rows in this file were read only as summaries from a fetch tool over documentation pages, were not tried on this PC, and are documented rather than observed here.
Items the file marks 'not verified' were not in the documentation pages it read, including the Agent tool hook input fields effort, run_in_background, name and isolation.

The file lists as not documented or uncertain: whether any hook can force a compaction or end a session, a token or budget cap for an interactive session, how an interactive session learns a background command finished, and the managed settings path on Windows.
Claude Code docs as read by the helper: the hook fields carry no context-size field, and no documented way exists to force a compaction or end a session from a hook.

Claude Code hooks doc [H]: hooks are configured under `hooks` in ~/.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, managed settings, plugins, or the frontmatter of a skill or subagent.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: PreToolUse runs before each tool call, including calls made inside subagents, and exit 2 or permissionDecision deny blocks the call.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: the PreToolUse decision can be allow, ask or defer, and updatedInput replaces the whole tool input.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: a PreToolUse timeout does not block unless onFailure is set to block, the if filter is best-effort, and allow cannot override a deny rule.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure run after the call and cannot undo the action.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: PostToolBatch runs after a parallel batch and before the next model call, has no matcher, and decision block or continue false stops the loop.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: UserPromptSubmit runs before a prompt is processed, sees only the prompt, and exit 2 or block stops it.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: Stop and SubagentStop hooks with exit 2 or decision block force continuation, capped at 8 in a row, and must check stop_hook_active to avoid loops.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: PreCompact and PostCompact run around compaction, exit 2 blocks a compaction, and a hook cannot force one.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: the SessionEnd default timeout is 1.5 s.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: for the Agent tool, the PreToolUse input lists prompt, description, subagent_type and model, and a hook can deny the call or rewrite its input.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: every hook event has transcript_path, which may lag the live conversation, and the status line receives context_window.used_percentage but cannot block anything.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: the same hooks fire for tool calls inside subagents, told apart by agent_id and agent_type, and hooks in a subagent's frontmatter run only while that subagent runs.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: matching hooks run in parallel, with default timeouts of 600 s for command and http, 60 s for agent and 30 s for prompt.
Claude Code permissions doc [P]: permission rules are checked in the order deny, then ask, then allow, and the first match wins.
Claude Code permissions doc [P]: a deny rule `Agent(Explore)` removes one subagent type, and a deny rule `Agent` removes delegation.
Claude Code permissions doc [P]: parameter rules such as `Agent(model:opus)` match a literal field, and an omitted parameter never matches.
Claude Code permissions doc [P]: Bash prefix and wildcard permission patterns miss a program called by path or inside `sh -c`, so a restriction that must hold needs the sandbox.
Claude Code permissions doc [P]: `Edit(path)` covers Write and NotebookEdit, and a Read deny is best-effort for Grep and Glob.
Claude Code permission modes doc [P][PM]: the modes are default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk and bypassPermissions, and bypassPermissions ignores allow rules while deny rules still apply.

Claude Code sub-agents doc [S]: agent definition frontmatter fields are model, effort, tools, disallowedTools, permissionMode, maxTurns, autoCompactWindow (100000 to 1000000), hooks, isolation and background.

Claude Code sub-agents doc [S]: a helper's model comes from the per-call model parameter first, then the frontmatter, then CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the parent's model, so a caller can override a definition's model.

Claude Code sub-agents doc [S]: with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL ignores both the per-call and frontmatter models, giving one model for every helper and not a tier per role.
Claude Code docs (session bounds): autoCompactWindow can be set in settings, per model under modelSettings, or with `/autocompact <tokens>`.
Claude Code docs (session bounds): CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS defaults to 20 and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH defaults to 3.
Claude Code docs (session bounds): maxTurns limits each subagent, and --max-budget-usd works only with -p.
Claude Code docs (session bounds): no session-wide token or context cap is documented.

Claude Code workflows doc [W]: workflow scripts decide which agent() calls run, in parallel() or pipeline(), with a model and schema per call; 16 agents at once by default (CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS, up to 256), 1,000 per run.
Claude Code workflows doc [W]: a workflow script has no file or shell access itself.

Claude Code headless doc [HL]: headless `claude -p` takes --allowedTools, --permission-mode, --settings, --agents, --max-budget-usd and --output-format json, --bare skips hooks, and SIGTERM ends the run after SessionEnd hooks.

Claude Code tools-reference and headless docs [TR][HL]: a background command a session starts keeps running, and a Monitor watch feeds each output line into the conversation (default deadline 5 min, most 30 min); no documented way exists for an outside watcher to interrupt a turn.
Claude Code channels doc [CH]: channels, where an MCP server pushes messages into a running session, are a research preview, and whether they can interrupt a turn is not documented.
Claude Code hooks doc [H]: a hook is itself a script the app runs at an event, and the file names that as the documented way for a script to act inside a session at the moment of a tool call.

Claude Code statusline doc [SL]: the status line is a script the app runs on events and on a timer, sees context_window (used_percentage, total_input_tokens), model, cost and rate_limits, and is display only.
Claude Code skills doc [SK]: in skills, disable-model-invocation: true and disallowed-tools are enforced, while allowed-tools only pre-approves.
Claude Code managed-settings doc [MS]: managed settings cannot be overridden by user or project settings and can require managed hooks only.
Claude Code docs (hook risks): a command hook runs shell commands with the user's permissions.
Claude Code docs (hook risks): a stalled PreToolUse hook lets the call through unless onFailure is set to block, exit 1 does not block, and only exit 2 does.
Claude Code docs (hook risks): hook output is capped at 10,000 characters per hook, and a background process must redirect its output or it can stall the call.
Claude Code docs: the documentation says static instructions belong in CLAUDE.md, hooks are for dynamic state, and 'Use the permission system for hard enforcement'.

The helper's short answer: hooks and permission rules are the only mechanisms that act at the moment of an action, and everything else either configures a session, which can be overridden, or runs after the fact.
